apis.description: Every public HTTP JSON endpoint on aadhar.sh: site search, the photo archive, the current playlist, coffee availability, the neighborhood Change Radar and Lens. Free, keyless and read-only.

The site MCP server: search and NLWeb ask, music, photos and their Fuji recipes, coffee availability, Change Radar, Lens, image inspection and transforms, and an HTTP representation vault. Keyless; read-only except the vault's capture and compare tools.
The Serendipity MCP server: community-curated events, who is going, and who keeps crossing paths. Keyless, read-only, public data only.

aadhar.sh/discovery.markdown: Pages answer Accept: text/markdown at their own URL with a Markdown twin.
